display_transformations.breast_mri: optional non-default rescale; 1st–99th percentiles, flat-image fallback min/max then +1; no HU or enhancement label implied
display_transformations.lung_window: rescale slope/intercept; C=-600 HU,W=1500 HU; clip [-1350,150]; scale/truncate uint8
display_transformations.modality_normal: default preprocessor; native modality comes from source series; MR and MRI share option B
display_transformations.soft_tissue_window: rescale slope/intercept; C=40 HU,W=400 HU; clip [-160,240]; scale/truncate uint8

task_contract.noise_implementation: Source name noise_gaussian; actual rng.integers(0,256,uint8), seed=42, ignores DICOM values, preserves dimensions, metadata={}. Not Gaussian or additive noise.
task_contract.preselected_indices: n<=5: all indices; n>5: int((n/5)*i+n/10), i=0..4; series stack-normal order (fallback InstanceNumber), not ZIP order
